utility.notes: Hawaiian Electric is the sole electric utility for the island of Oahu (City and County of Honolulu), confirmed via the utility's own site.

value.name: Hawaiian Electric Company (HECO)
value.notes: Per Hawaiian Electric's own 'Smart Renewable Energy Programs' page: as of the program's rollout (beginning ~April 2024), most new residential rooftop solar customers choose between 'Smart Renewable Energy (SRE) Export' (export bill credits, no project size limit) and 'SRE Non-Export' (no export credits, no size limit); a 'Bring Your Own Device Plus (BYOD Plus)' incentive is available for battery installations dispatched during specified periods. Legacy 'Net Energy Metering (NEM)' and 'NEM Plus' customers are NOT required to transition and may instead enroll additional capacity under 'NEM Plus' or 'NEM Plus Limited Export.' Older programs (Customer Grid-Supply, Customer Grid-Supply Plus, Smart Export, Standard Interconnection Agreement, Customer Self-Supply) are closed to new customers and are being transitioned into the SRE framework over time (transitions after 7 years in-program began Oct. 1, 2024). All Smart Renewable Energy participants must have an advanced (smart) meter.

city.notes: The City and County of Honolulu is a consolidated city-county government covering the entire island of Oahu — there are no separate incorporated municipalities on Oahu, so this single record represents the real AHJ for all of Oahu, not just the city center. Per the mission's Hawaii-specific instruction, no separate sub-county city pages are created beneath this county-level AHJ.

inspection_steps.notes: DPP's Solar Permit page focuses on the HNL Build application workflow (Quick Permit flags, contractor consent, phases-of-work formatting) rather than a post-issuance inspection checklist; not found this session.

value.program_or_pathway: Solar Quick Permit (HNL Build) / Expedited Clean Energy BPA for townhomes
other_conditions: Standard Solar Quick Permits process even if the property is in a Special Management Area (SMA), Special District, subject to a Unilateral Agreement, subject to Ewa Highway Impact Fee, refers to DLNR, or is a Lot Flags Slide Lot — applicant must answer 'Yes' to the first HNL Build question to avoid being blocked by these flags

The separate expedited 'Clean Energy' Building Permit Application pathway (Revised Ordinances of Honolulu Section 18-5-10) is limited to 20 kW systems and primarily targets townhomes; eligible project types include solar PV (with or without energy storage), solar thermal/electric hot water heating, and EV charging stations

permit_fees.notes: DPP's own solar-specific pages did not publish a fee schedule this session; the City's general building-permit fee schedule was not located/confirmed as solar-specific.
